description: Uninstall an app by package name, at once and without a backup. keep_data=true keeps app data (-k). The reverse is adb_install. For system packages, reversible bulk operations and backups, use adb_app.

keep_data.description: Keep the app data and cache (-k). Default false.

package.description: Package name, e.g. com.example.app (adb_app action=list lists them).

serial.description: Device serial from adb_devices. Optional when exactly one device is connected.

name: adb_uninstall
title: Uninstall app
